purpose: Taiwan-MOE-first pronunciation cross-check. Differences are review items and must not be auto-applied without lexical/context review.

interpretation.exact_match: Corpus and MOE pronunciation sets agree after NFC and whitespace normalization.
interpretation.review_required: At least one pronunciation differs. Additional corpus readings may be rare/historical CNS readings rather than errors.
interpretation.not_in_source: The exact headword is outside this pinned dictionary and needs another Taiwanese authority or manual review.
